Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 28, 2026

What this page is

The Homeland RV Production Guide is a fan-made guide for the game Aniimo. It does not ask you to create an account, and it does not collect personal information from you directly.

Advertising

This site plans to use Google AdSense to show ads. Google and its partners may use cookies and similar technologies to show ads based on your visits to this site and other sites on the internet.

  • You can turn off personalized ads in Google's Ad Settings.
  • Read how Google uses information from sites that use its services.

Information collected automatically

Like most websites, the advertising provider may collect cookie identifiers, device and browser information, IP address (used for approximate location and fraud prevention), and which pages are viewed. The owner of this guide does not receive your personal information from this.

Cookies

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking cookies will not break the guide, but ads may be less relevant to you.

Children

This guide is about a video game and may interest younger players. It is meant for a general audience. Google does not show personalized ads to users it knows are under 13 (or the applicable age in their region).

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. The effective date at the top will change when that happens.
